name: sem
title_zh: 实体级 diff 的语义版本控制，git 之上多一层
tagline_zh: git 只告诉你哪行变了，它告诉你哪个函数改了、谁调的它、影响面多大。28 种语言 tree-sitter 解析。
tagline_en: Git shows lines; sem shows functions, callers, and blast radius. Tree-sitter across 28 languages—a changelog.
desc_en: Semantic version control => entity-level diffs, blame, and impact analysis on top of git. 28 languages via tree-sitter. Built for coding agents.
why_zh: 把 diff 从行级抬到实体级：改动一个函数，连带 blame 和影响分析一起给。
why_en: Raises diffs from lines to entities: rename a function and get blame plus impact in one pass. Agents stop.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 git 已跟踪的代码文件；二进制、非 tree-sitter 语言、跨仓库重构不解析。产物是分析视图。
limit_en: Only git-tracked code files; binaries, non-tree-sitter langs, cross-repo refactors are skipped. Outputs analysis views—no auto-edits or commits.
title_en: Semantic version control: entity-level diffs on git
